description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/HelpCentre/Contact. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Creates a legacy authenticated help-centre contact ticket. Domain: support. Entity: support_ticket. Operation: create. Scope: authenticated_user. Use when: Use for legacy contact form submissions where a visible ticket id is not required. AIChat must prefer Contact2 when it needs to show the created ticket reference/link. Input: rq: ContactModel. Main fields: Message: string, Attachments: Attachment[]. Optional X-HGR-Client: ai_chat identifies the HGR AI chat gateway; normal web requests omit it. Output: Boolean success flag only. It does not return a visible ticket id. The creation event actor is human for web submissions or ai_chat for HGR AI chat; the first message remains an inbound customer message. Search terms: helpcentre contact. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_helpcentre_contact
